name: Alfman Uranos
original_name: アルフマン・ウラノス
source:
Alfman is the Chancellor of the "Grand Bell" organization [url=/c3685]Croix[/url] works for. He wields a lollipop gun to scare his subordinates. There seems to be ulterior motives to his actions, and he is extremely self-loving. He is an intimidating man and takes the idea of Metafalica very seriously. [url=/c55886]Cloche[/url], in particular, finds it difficult to work with him.

[From [url=http://artonelico.wikia.com/wiki/Alfman_Uranous]Ar Tonelico Wiki[/url]]
